$comment: Foundational micro-skills: the leaves of every prerequisite detour. Each gets a short interactive micro-lesson plus practice. level 'pre-11' = Class 9-10 content; 'bridge-11' = Class 11 content outside the curated subset (safe for any Class 11 or 12 student). Nothing here is Class 12, so a Class 11 student can always be routed here.
